*From language to proof.* Lecture notes with tutorial exercises, academic year 2026–2027. This text is made available for reading online.

```{=html}
<div id="pdf-status" class="pdf-status">Loading the course…</div>
<div id="pdf-reader" class="pdf-reader" aria-label="Mathematical Logic, Licence 2"></div>
<noscript><p>JavaScript is required to read the course online.</p></noscript>
<script type="module">
(async function () {
  var PDF_URL = 'files/logique-mathematique-L2.pdf';
  var LIB = new URL('assets/pdfjs/', document.baseURI).href;
  var box = document.getElementById('pdf-reader');
  var status = document.getElementById('pdf-status');
  box.addEventListener('contextmenu', function (e) { e.preventDefault(); });
  try {
    var pdfjs = await import(LIB + 'pdf.min.js');
    pdfjs.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = LIB + 'pdf.worker.min.js';
    var pdf = await pdfjs.getDocument({ url: PDF_URL }).promise;
    var first = await pdf.getPage(1);
    var base = first.getViewport({ scale: 1 });
    var dpr = Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 2);
    status.textContent = pdf.numPages + ' pages';
    var holders = [];
    for (var i = 1; i <= pdf.numPages; i++) {
      var d = document.createElement('div');
      d.className = 'pdf-page';
      d.style.aspectRatio = base.width + ' / ' + base.height;
      d.dataset.page = i;
      box.appendChild(d);
      holders.push(d);
    }
    var render = async function (d) {
      if (d.dataset.done) return;
      d.dataset.done = '1';
      var page = await pdf.getPage(Number(d.dataset.page));
      var vp = page.getViewport({ scale: (d.clientWidth / base.width) * dpr });
      var c = document.createElement('canvas');
      c.width = Math.floor(vp.width);
      c.height = Math.floor(vp.height);
      d.appendChild(c);
      await page.render({ canvasContext: c.getContext('2d'), viewport: vp }).promise;
    };
    var io = new IntersectionObserver(function (entries) {
      entries.forEach(function (e) { if (e.isIntersecting) render(e.target); });
    }, { rootMargin: '1200px 0px' });
    holders.forEach(function (h) { io.observe(h); });
  } catch (err) {
    status.textContent = 'The viewer could not be loaded. Please try another browser.';
  }
})();
</script>
```
